findings.summary: The dollar-rate line cites European Central Bank rates, which confuses the reader. They also can't tell whether the inflation button is on or off.
Fund terms are never explained: trustee (נאמן), 4D vs 4A, tracker fund vs ETF, and tags such as עסקת החלף and כמה דרכים יחד.
The hedged fund's range (+2,212 to −23,766 ₪) confused and scared the reader, with no explanation of what it means.
In the 2022–2025 yearly table the numbers are printed on top of each other, so the reader can't read them.
The 'start from one choice' chart puts 'עכשיו' (now) on the MTF/Jerusalem bar. That isn't the reader's situation, because they have no account yet, so the starting point makes no sense to them.
The colour key for the cost-bar segments is far from the bank list, so the reader ignored the coloured bars.
It's unclear what '+0.37% בשנה · שנה אחת' is measured against, and what the purple dotted underlines under numbers do.
The reader isn't sure what 'בכסף של היום' (today's money) means or how much would actually be in the account. They also don't know whether the default 7% return is realistic.
'הזוג הבא בתור' (the next pair) doesn't say which bank and fund it is. The sentence about 25% of any difference going to tax was not understood.

Information the reader wanted is missing: risk of a market fall near retirement, how to open the account, how safe the money is, fees for taking it out, a provident fund (קופת גמל להשקעה) as an alternative, and the final amount in future shekels.
